mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TASK /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.task.design.insertDesign */ ( TASK_NAME, TASK_DES, TASK_STATUS, IS_TEST, TASK_DEPTH, STG_ID, PT_TASK_ID, PT_TASK_NAME, TASK_SEQ, TASK_ST, TASK_ET, TASK_RST, TASK_RET, TASK_ASI, TASK_RATE, PJT_ID ) VALUES ( #{taskName}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskDes}, ''), ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskStatus}, ''), '대기'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{isTest}, ''), 0), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskDepth}, ''), 1), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{stgId}, ''), 0), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{ptTaskId}, ''), 0), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{ptTaskName}, ''), ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskSeq}, ''), 1), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskSt}, ''), null), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskEt}, ''), null), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskRst}, ''), null), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskRet}, ''), null), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskAsi}, ''), ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskRate}, ''), 0), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{pjtId}, ''), 1) )
mapper.update: UPDATE TASK /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.task.design.updateDesign */ SET TASK_NAME = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskName}, ''), TASK_NAME), TASK_DES = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskDes}, ''), TASK_DES), TASK_STATUS = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskStatus}, ''), TASK_STATUS), IS_TEST = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{isTest}, ''), IS_TEST), TASK_DEPTH = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskDepth}, ''), TASK_DEPTH), STG_ID = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{stgId}, ''), STG_ID), PT_TASK_ID = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{ptTaskId}, ''), PT_TASK_ID), PT_TASK_NAME = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{ptTaskName}, ''), PT_TASK_NAME), TASK_SEQ = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskSeq}, ''), TASK_SEQ), TASK_ST = CASE WHEN #{taskSt} IS NULL OR #{taskSt} = '' THEN NULL ELSE #{taskSt} END, TASK_ET = CASE WHEN #{taskEt} IS NULL OR #{taskEt} = '' THEN NULL ELSE #{taskEt} END, TASK_RST = CASE WHEN #{taskRst} IS NULL OR #{taskRst} = '' THEN NULL ELSE #{taskRst} END, TASK_RET = CASE WHEN #{taskRet} IS NULL OR #{taskRet} = '' THEN NULL ELSE #{taskRet} END, TASK_ASI = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskAsi}, ''), TASK_ASI), TASK_RATE = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskRate}, ''), TASK_RATE), PJT_ID = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{pjtId}, ''), PJT_ID) WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.task.design.selectDesign */ t.TASK_ID as taskId, t.TASK_NAME as taskName, t.TASK_DES as taskDes, t.TASK_STATUS as taskStatus, t.IS_TEST as isTest, t.TASK_DEPTH as taskDepth, t.STG_ID as stgId, t.PT_TASK_ID as ptTaskId, t.TASK_SEQ as taskSeq, t.TASK_ST as taskSt, t.TASK_ET as taskEt, t.TASK_RST as taskRst, t.TASK_RET as taskRet, t.TASK_ASI as taskAsi, t.TASK_RATE as taskRate, t.PJT_ID as pjtId,
COALESCE(pt.TASK_NAME, t.PT_TASK_NAME) as ptTaskName, s.STG_NAME as stgName -- 단계명 FROM TASK t LEFT JOIN TASK pt ON t.PT_TASK_ID = pt.TASK_ID -- 상위 업무와 조인 LEFT JOIN STG s ON t.STG_ID = s.STG_ID -- 단계와 조인 WHERE t.TASK_ID = #{taskId}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.task.design.selectListCountDesign */ COUNT(*) totcnt FROM TASK WHERE stg_id between 1 and 5 AND PJT_ID = #{pjtId}
AND TASK_NAME like '%${scTaskName}%'
AND TASK_STATUS like '%${scTaskStatus}%'
AND IS_TEST like '%${scIsTest}%'
AND STG_ID like '%${scStgId}%'

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.task.design.selectListCountDesign */ COUNT(*) totcnt FROM TASK WHERE stg_id = 6 AND PJT_ID = #{pjtId}
AND TASK_NAME like '%${scTaskName}%'
AND TASK_STATUS like '%${scTaskStatus}%'
AND IS_TEST like '%${scIsTest}%'
AND STG_ID like '%${scStgId}%'

WITH RECURSIVE task_tree AS ( -- 1단계: 최상위 업무들 (pt_task_id = 0) SELECT task_id, task_name, pt_task_id, task_depth, task_seq, stg_id, pjt_id, CAST(LPAD(task_seq, 3, '0') AS VARCHAR(100)) as sort_path FROM task WHERE pt_task_id = 0 AND pjt_id = #{pjtId} AND stg_id BETWEEN 1 AND 5
UNION ALL
-- 2-3단계: 하위 업무들 재귀 조회 SELECT t.task_id, t.task_name, t.pt_task_id, t.task_depth, t.task_seq, t.stg_id, t.pjt_id, CAST(CONCAT(tt.sort_path, '-', LPAD(t.task_seq, 3, '0')) AS VARCHAR(100)) as sort_path FROM task t INNER JOIN task_tree tt ON t.pt_task_id = tt.task_id WHERE t.task_depth <=5 AND t.pjt_id = #{pjtId} AND t.stg_id BETWEEN 1 AND 5 ) SELECT task_id as taskId, task_name as taskName, pt_task_id as ptTaskId, task_depth as taskDepth, task_seq as taskSeq, stg_id as stgId, pjt_id as pjtId FROM task_tree ORDER BY stg_id, sort_path

WITH RECURSIVE task_tree AS ( -- 1단계: 최상위 업무들 (pt_task_id = 0) SELECT task_id, task_name, pt_task_id, task_depth, task_seq, stg_id, pjt_id, CAST(LPAD(task_seq, 3, '0') AS VARCHAR(100)) as sort_path FROM task WHERE pt_task_id = 0 AND pjt_id = #{pjtId} AND stg_id = 6
UNION ALL
-- 2-3단계: 하위 업무들 재귀 조회 SELECT t.task_id, t.task_name, t.pt_task_id, t.task_depth, t.task_seq, t.stg_id, t.pjt_id, CAST(CONCAT(tt.sort_path, '-', LPAD(t.task_seq, 3, '0')) AS VARCHAR(100)) as sort_path FROM task t INNER JOIN task_tree tt ON t.pt_task_id = tt.task_id WHERE t.task_depth <=5 AND t.pjt_id = #{pjtId} AND t.stg_id = 6 ) SELECT task_id as taskId, task_name as taskName, pt_task_id as ptTaskId, task_depth as taskDepth, task_seq as taskSeq, stg_id as stgId, pjt_id as pjtId FROM task_tree ORDER BY stg_id, sort_path
